reason: B is the stronger proposal because it defines a specific alloy, intervention, baseline, test conditions, quantitative outcomes, and decisive comparative experiment, while Mo-related strengthening and passivation have direct supporting evidence. Its σ-phase and room-temperature grain-boundary-creep mechanism remains questionable and must be verified—σ can embrittle the alloy—but A is too compositionally and procedurally vague and its claim that precipitates inherently improve corrosion resistance is poorly grounded.
